- **Reminder button:** it sets a phone reminder, "Pack for Porto", for Thu 15 Oct at 19:00, the evening before your Fri 16 Oct 07:10 flight. It takes the date from the "out fri 16 oct 07:10" line in your note. I chose 19:00 myself, since you didn't give a time.
- **Rest of the app:** it also shows the trip facts (flights, hotel, budget), your ideas list, and the "to do before" checklist. You can tick checklist items there and they update in the note.
